answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, Sybil resistance can be enforced via a computational trust kernel that anchors cryptographic identities to verifiable hardware execution roots. Akin to a subterranean vine anchoring a sprawling meadow, this architectural core binds each authorized agent's operational state to unique silicon attestation proofs. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities incurs prohibitive capital expenditure, as every fabricated node demands matching physical hardware assets and continuous cryptographic validation costs.
